FAQ.sectionDescription: Common questions from students about MERN stack, live classes, projects, payment, and course access.

FAQ.question: I'm a complete beginner. Is this course for me?
FAQ.answer: Absolutely! The course is structured from beginner to advanced level, covering fundamentals of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, up to complex MERN stack production workflows.

FAQ.question: What happens if I miss a live class?
FAQ.answer: You will get lifetime access to full HD recorded sessions of every live class on your dashboard.

FAQ.question: What software or tools will I need?
FAQ.answer: We will use free industry-standard tools like VS Code, Node.js, Git, and MongoDB. Complete setup guidance will be provided in Class 1.

FAQ.question: How can I complete the payment?
FAQ.answer: You can pay using bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Bank Transfers, or Credit/Debit Cards. EMI option is also available.

FAQ.question: Can I start job hunting or freelancing after this course?
FAQ.answer: Yes, you will build 6+ industry-level projects that can be featured directly in your portfolio to target local or remote tech jobs and freelancing.

FAQ.question: How does the money-back guarantee work?
FAQ.answer: If you are not satisfied within 7 days of enrollment, you can claim a 100% refund with no questions asked.

Privacy.intro: At Cobalt Studio, we respect your privacy and are dedicated to safeguarding your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your information when you interact with our website, course portal, and developer tools.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.description: We collect information to provide better services to our students and community members. This includes:
items: Account Information: Name, email address, avatar photo, and role when you sign in via Firebase Authentication.
Enrollment & Transaction Details: Course registrations, batch selections, payment confirmation metadata (processed securely via bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or Bank Transfers).
Technical & Log Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, and usage telemetry via Vercel Analytics.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
usage.description: Your information is used strictly for operational and educational purposes, including:
items: Providing access to enrolled courses, live class sessions, dashboard materials, and developer tools.
Facilitating 1-on-1 GitHub pull request code reviews and mentor feedback.
Sending essential course announcements, schedule updates, and security alerts.
Analyzing platform performance to optimize loading speeds and user interface experience.

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing & Third-Party Services
sharing.description: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties or advertisers. We share data only with trusted infrastructure providers required to operate Cobalt Studio:
items: Firebase (Google): User authentication, secure database storage, and session tokens.
Vercel: Web hosting and privacy-focused site analytics.
Payment Partners: Secured payment gateways for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and card transactions.

security.title: 4. Data Security & Storage
security.description: We employ robust technical and organizational security measures, including HTTPS encryption, Firebase Security Rules, and restricted access protocols to safeguard your personal data from unauthorized access or disclosure.

rights.title: 5. Your Data Rights & Choices
rights.description: You have the right to inspect, update, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. You can modify your account details directly from your Cobalt Studio Profile or contact us to request full account removal.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies & Local Storage
cookies.description: We use essential cookies and browser local storage solely to retain your session authentication, language preference (English/Bangla), and color theme (Dark/Light mode). No intrusive tracking cookies are utilized.

contact.title: 7. Contact Privacy Support
contact.description: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please reach out to our team at:

conduct.title: 4. Community Conduct & Guidelines
conduct.description: We foster a collaborative, professional, and inclusive learning environment across our live classes, code reviews, and community channels.

Sharing pirated software, credentials, or malicious scripts will result in immediate ban without refund.

Refund.intro: We stand behind the quality of our bootcamps and courses. Cobalt Studio offers a hassle-free 7-Day Money-Back Guarantee so you can enroll with 100% confidence.
Refund.guaranteeDescription: If within 7 days of enrollment or class start date you feel the course isn't a perfect fit for your learning goals, simply send us a request and we will refund 100% of your payment.

eligibility.title: 1. Eligibility & Guarantee Period
eligibility.description: Our refund policy is designed to give you complete peace of mind when starting your learning journey:
items: Refund requests must be submitted within 7 calendar days of your enrollment date.
Applies to full course fee payments as well as initial installment payments.
No minimum progress restriction — if you're not satisfied, you get a full refund.

process.title: 2. How to Request a Refund
process.description: Requesting a refund is quick and straightforward. Follow these simple steps:
items: Email Support: Send an email to studioredlabbd@gmail.com with subject 'Refund Request - [Your Name]'.
Provide Details: Mention your registered account email and payment Transaction ID (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or Bank Reference).
Verification: Our support team will verify your transaction within 24 hours and initiate the refund.

payout.title: 3. Payout Method & Timeline
payout.description: Refunds are disbursed directly back to your original payment method:
items: Mobile Financial Services (bKash/Nagad/Rocket): Refund credited within 3 to 5 business days.
Bank Transfers & Cards: Refund credited within 5 to 7 business days depending on bank clearance.
Zero Deduction: You will receive 100% of the amount paid without any hidden charges or processing fees.

access.title: 4. Course Access Revocation
access.description: Once your refund request is approved and processed, your access to live classes, dashboard video modules, GitHub PR reviews, and VIP developer channels will be closed.
